# Alcantara Safety Solutions

> llms.txt is an optional, experimental discovery file. It does not guarantee indexing, citation, or visibility in any AI system.
> Site: https://asafetysolutions.com

Alcantara Safety Solutions is a British Columbia workplace safety consultancy. It writes custom workplace safety plans, safe work procedures, hazard and risk assessments, and safety manuals, runs compliance reviews against the WorkSafeBC OHS Regulation, and provides ongoing safety coordination for construction, landscaping, warehousing, and civil & infrastructure businesses across British Columbia. Every plan is written from scratch for the client's actual operations, equipment, and locations — no templates.

## Contact

- Phone: (778) 954-1988
- Email: karen@alcantarasafety.com
- Contact page: https://asafetysolutions.com/contact.html
- Hours: Monday–Friday, 8:00am–6:00pm Pacific (as published on the site)

## Services

- Custom safety plan creation — full hazard assessment, safe work procedures, training matrix, emergency protocols, PPE program, audit-ready documentation. Pricing factors: facility size, complexity, and crew size; fixed-fee quote before work begins. https://asafetysolutions.com/safety-plan-creation.html
- Compliance consulting / reviews — regulation-by-regulation gap analysis, documentation audit, corrective action plan. Priced by scope. https://asafetysolutions.com/compliance-consulting.html
- Hazard & risk assessments — on-site assessments with a scored risk register and photo-documented findings. https://asafetysolutions.com/risk-assessments.html
- Safe work procedures, safety manuals, orientation packages, contractor safety packages, COR preparation, and ongoing safety coordination — see services hub. https://asafetysolutions.com/services.html

## Industries Served

Construction, landscaping, warehousing, and civil & infrastructure. https://asafetysolutions.com/industries.html

## Service Areas (British Columbia)

Lower Mainland, Vancouver Island, Interior, and North — on-site in Metro Vancouver and remotely elsewhere in BC. Full list: https://asafetysolutions.com/service-areas.html

## Process

1. Free initial consultation by phone or email
2. Scope and written flat-fee quote
3. Site walk-through / assessment
4. Custom document development
5. Review together and rollout support

Details: https://asafetysolutions.com/safety-plan-creation.html#after-enquiry
